name: API Diagnostics Suite
author: KryonOS Team
description: Automated universal hardware & software API test suite for KryonOS. Systematically validates all OS subsystems: System, Device, FS, Crypto, Audio, Inputs, Display, GPIO, PWM, I2C, Net, GPS, LocalAI, IPC, and 3D.
changelog: Initial release of comprehensive automated API test suite with live assertions, sub-millisecond benchmarks, categorical breakdown, and persistent test report export.
